title: 5 mm shelf-pin jig
engineering: Two-pass shelf jig layout keeps 32 mm pitch across the indexing splice and 37 mm setback.
physical_check: Drill both positions on one scrap panel. Measure the splice, hole setback and cross-fit between opposite shelf sides.

title: Low-profile PCB bench vise
engineering: Low-profile spring-jaw PCB vise sectional layout supports 22, 45 and 70 mm coupons with 1.4 mm underside clearance.
physical_check: Fit three scrap boards with representative bottom-side parts and check grip, component clearance and connector access.

title: 18-contact programming and test fixture
engineering: 18-probe SPI adapter cassette, asymmetric reverse-load tab, and 54 simulated continuity and travel cases.
physical_check: Use an actual SPI adapter and continuity meter to verify all 18 named leads, shared ground continuity, and rejection of a reversed cassette.

title: Pick-and-place staging carrier
engineering: Transfer staging carrier with three fiducials, 5 mm local nozzle clearance and 6 mm travel clearance above clamps.
physical_check: Measure the installed machine pattern and safe Z. Dry-run global fiducial recognition, then sample all placement approaches with no paste or parts.

title: Registration frame for small PCB stencils
engineering: Hinged stencil frame holds four witness apertures within 0.064 mm of their registered pads across tolerance corners.
physical_check: Run, lift, clean and reload a scrap stencil frame ten times. Measure witness print position and whether the board moves.

title: Desktop robot manual tool coupling
engineering: Manual coupler with 3.2 mm hook engagement and 0.355 mm geometry-only tip drift at 70 mm reach.
physical_check: On a catch mat, swap a 100 g dummy tool 100 times and measure static drift and retention after latching.
